Under the release policy, the defensible certification path is to certify with explicit model-card disclosure of this material limitation for the named launch use case, while relying on monitoring and rollback as supplemental controls rather than substitutes for disclosure (ISTRESS-ROLLOUT-MONITORING-027-POLICY, ISTRESS-ROLLOUT-MONITORING-027-NIST-MEASURE).
